invariants.rationale: The result object is assigned and interacted with, so it must not be null at the return point.
The setWriteStatuses method sets the internal write statuses reference to the newly created statuses list, which is stored in result, matching the returned value.
The returned list (statuses) is assigned as the write statuses for result, so their sizes must match.
The write statuses in result reference the same object as the returned statuses.
A new list is produced by the index update process and returned, which is not the original writeStatuses parameter.
